prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: single high-resolution square raster environment background for StartX, a business adventure card game.
Primary request: look straight down from the fourth-to-sixth floor of a low-to-midrise office building, with surrounding city streets, tiny pedestrians and neighboring office buildings visible on all four sides.
Composition: a true overhead plan view, no horizon, no isometric diamond. A large EMPTY square office floor occupies exactly the central 50 percent of image width and height, with its straight edges aligned to the image edges: left at 25%, right at 75%, top at 25%, bottom at 75%. This central square is a quiet uniform pale ivory floor, absolutely no objects, furniture, text, grid or marks inside it; the game will overlay a live board there. Around this central square, show the outside walls/windows descending toward the streets below, then urban roads, sidewalks, zebra crossings, small walking people and neighboring low and midrise buildings. Street details on every side of the central office floor. The central office footprint must stay unobstructed and square, no tall objects overlapping it. Buildings toward the outer edges can be cropped by the image boundary.
Style: polished original 2D hand-painted comic game environment, clear dark line work, softly shaded architectural volumes, appealing readable small details. Match a light ivory card board with warm cream and muted teal city architecture, restrained coral accents, gray blue roads. The city should feel lively and believable, with clearly identifiable tiny pedestrians. Soft sunny daytime lighting, subtle height shadows suggesting a modest office floor above street level. Crisp high resolution, preferably 4096 x 4096.
Constraints: environment art only, opaque full image, no characters in foreground, no cards, no UI, no buttons, no lettering, no logos, no text or numbers, no watermark. Straight top-down square floor, no perspective tilt of the central square.
